# Etsy

> > Etsy is a global online marketplace connecting creative entrepreneurs with buyers seeking unique handmade, vintage, and craft supply items.

Etsy provides a comprehensive platform for sellers and buyers, offering developer tools through the Etsy API (Open API v3) for marketplace integration, along with buyer protection programs and customer support resources.

## Key Topics

- Etsy API
- Open API v3
- Etsy Purchase Protection
- Marketplace Integration
- Developer Portal
- Buyer Guarantee
- Order Issues
- Case Resolution
- Refund Policy
- Customer Support
- API Documentation
- Getting Started

## Buyer Protection & Support

- [Etsy Purchase Protection](https://www.etsy.com/etsy-purchase-protection): Etsy Purchase Protection program for buyer guarantees and order issues

## Developer Resources

- [Developer Portal](https://www.etsy.com/developers): Etsy API developer portal with Open API v3 and marketplace integration
